_comment: Example CV master data for the applyd CV pipeline. Copy this file to cv_master.json and populate with your own details. The populated cv_master.json is gitignored so your personal data never enters version control. Shape is the source of truth for scripts/cv/build-cvs.js — every top-level key here is consumed by the renderer, so keep the shape when you populate.
name: Alex Sample
positioning_line: I make data trustworthy, then I make it useful.

employers.role: Analytics Engineer · Example Analytics Ltd · London, UK
employers.summary: B2B SaaS analytics vendor. Owned the customer-facing data layer end to end, from ingestion into a cloud warehouse through modelled marts to a BI service layer used by 10 internal stakeholders.
bullets: Consolidated 3 upstream systems into a single warehouse on a deduplicated account spine, with 20+ dbt models and CI-gated tests on every merge.
Re-architected the highest-volume revenue models as incremental with deterministic hash IDs, cutting daily compute roughly 10%.
Introduced 100+ dbt and pytest tests across staging and marts, catching 10 upstream data-quality regressions before release.
Shipped a lightweight FastAPI service exposing account-level metrics to the customer dashboard team, replacing ad-hoc CSV exports.
Ran a weekly office-hour for analysts moving from spreadsheet reporting to SQL, tripling self-serve query volume in a quarter.
employers.stack: dbt, PostgreSQL, Python, FastAPI, GitHub Actions, Docker.

employers.role: Data Analyst · Sample Data Co · Remote
employers.summary: Consumer subscription analytics. Reporting and dashboarding across acquisition, retention, and churn for a 100k-customer product.
bullets: Rebuilt the weekly reporting pack in a BI tool, cutting handover time from about a day to under an hour.
Wrote and documented 50+ analytical SQL queries reused by the marketing and product teams.
Ran a cohort-based retention study that surfaced a 10% drop-off at the 30-day mark, leading to a lifecycle-email fix.
Owned data-quality reviews on the ingestion side, closing three long-standing joins that had silently split accounts.
employers.stack: SQL, Python, Power BI, Airflow, Snowflake.

employers.role: Junior Data Analyst · Placeholder Retail GmbH · Berlin, DE
employers.summary: Retail chain analytics. Store-level reporting and pricing analytics for a mid-size grocery chain across 50 sites.
bullets: Automated the weekly store performance report in Python, freeing about 10 hours of manual spreadsheet work per week.
Built a pricing-elasticity dashboard covering 1,000 SKUs, which fed the quarterly range review.
Contributed to a data-integrity overhaul that improved core dataset accuracy 10% over six months.

projects.title: Sample Analytics Dashboard
projects.summary: Single-screen BI report on a public retail dataset. Data model in dbt, metrics in DAX, published as a Power BI report against a Postgres source.

projects.title: Example Data Pipeline
projects.summary: End-to-end ingestion pipeline: Python extractors, Airflow orchestration, dbt transformation, PostgreSQL warehouse, all containerised. Runs on a schedule against a public API.

projects.title: Placeholder ML Model
projects.summary: Gradient-boosted classifier on a public dataset with SHAP-driven feature attribution. Reproducible notebook plus a small inference CLI, tested with pytest.

projects.title: Sample Time-Series Forecasting
projects.summary: R-based univariate forecasting on 1,000 daily observations of a public series. ARIMA, ETS, and a decision-rule combining residual and stationarity diagnostics.

projects.title: Example Airport Schema Design
projects.summary: SQL Server schema for a simplified airport ticketing platform: 7 core entities, integrity enforced by construction with CHECK constraints, UNIQUE constraints, and foreign keys.

honest_boundaries: Production warehouse: PostgreSQL. Snowflake / BigQuery are on skills, not production.
ML scope: applied classification and forecasting in portfolio projects. Not full MLOps.
